description: One-time validation of the frozen 1.5.0 wire corpus (recorded at 8b79eae5 by docs/bugs/evidence/MA-BUG-20261104-001/repro-client-archive-chain) against the installed client f002e08. Run on 2026-11-05 by re-running the same chain test in a throwaway f002e08 worktree (Node 20, real better-sqlite3). Timestamps and run-random UUIDs are masked; batch bodies compared as sets.
result: Every scenario sends the same multiset of requests with the same per-request outcomes. Where the order differs it differs only between requests whose order is decided by run-random ids (child C vs child D attendee and tick requests); two f002e08 runs differ from each other in the same way. No skill_mastery request occurs in these chains, so the expected f002e08 difference (no skill_mastery) does not arise.
